description: Boundary coverage for the HTTP front door beyond the documented examples: the well-known liveness endpoint /ping is served unauthenticated with a 200 status and an 'OK' body; the site root is a protected path so it yields a 403 sign-in challenge whose embedded redirect target is '/'; a protected path that carries a query string embeds the full original request URI (path plus query) as the redirect target; requesting the robots endpoint while extracting the redirect target finds no embedded target.
